item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, **49% of housing units** are in one-story buildings, according to the *Geometry Stories* characteristic (Table 11).

Its data source is **U.S. EIA 2009 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**. Stories count floors above grade: **basements are excluded**, while finished attics are included.

Source: [ResStock Technical Reference Guide, 2025 Release 1, p. 54](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=54).
